accepted_risks.topic: Timeline mismatch between paper.txt and README_1/README_2
accepted_risks.decision: README_1.md and README_2.md describe a materially later and restructured state of the project (a 'V1' agent SDK, a separate 'Agent Canvas' product, new benchmarks including a dedicated safety benchmark) than the architecture and evaluation paper.txt reports (versions v1.5-v1.8, 2024). The paper's narrative and all reported results are grounded in paper.txt. README material is used only to (a) bound a limitation that the evaluated implementation is a superseded snapshot of an actively developed project, and (b) briefly frame continued community development. No result, benchmark, or claim from the READMEs' later system is presented as evaluated in this paper.

Every negative/underperformance case found while cross-tabulating Tables 4-6 (ToolQA with gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 at 2.3%; MiniWoB++ vs. the CC-NET specialist baseline; the MINT code subset; Entity Deduction Arena) is reported in the main Results text, near the claim it qualifies, rather than omitted or relocated to a supplement that does not exist in this deliverable.

Story pattern set to 'method_first' (Problem -> Platform/Method -> Experiments across task categories -> generality finding), mirroring the source paper's own organization, since no user was available to express a preference and this pattern fits a systems/platform paper with one central artifact and a multi-benchmark evaluation.
